title: The Ghost Army
excerpt: Secret U.S. Army unit of artists and technicians that used inflatable tanks, sound effects and fake radio traffic to impersonate whole divisions in Europe in 1944-45.
excerptEs: Unidad secreta del Ejército de EE. UU. formada por artistas y técnicos que usó tanques hinchables, efectos de sonido y radio falsa para suplantar divisiones enteras en Europa en 1944-45.

sources.title: U.S. Congress: Ghost Army Congressional Gold Medal Act, Public Law 117-85 (2022), findings
The National WWII Museum: The Ghost Army – Canvas and Camouflage (Chase Tomlin, 2024)
